ppo-dispatch.title: PPO dispatch against SPTF and LP
ppo-dispatch.reports: Paired difference in tonnes per hour over paired seeds, with its 95 % interval
ppo-dispatch.criterion: At least 30 paired seeds; "beats SPTF / LP" only if the paired 95 % interval of the t/h difference excludes 0, otherwise "no significant difference" (SC-007-01)

attention-dispatch.title: Attention policy against SPTF, LP and PPO
attention-dispatch.reports: Paired difference in tonnes per hour, overall and per fleet size
attention-dispatch.criterion: At least 30 paired seeds; the same decision rule as for PPO; the per-fleet-size comparison is reported (SC-007-02)

slope-forecasters.title: Slope forecasters against inverse velocity
slope-forecasters.reports: Time-of-failure error as a share of lead time on seeded synthetic events, per learned arm
slope-forecasters.criterion: Median error at most 0.10 of the lead time at both noise levels; "better than inverse velocity" only when the paired interval lies above 0 (SC-010-01, SC-010-02)

gns-granular.title: Graph-network surrogate against the DEM solver
gns-granular.reports: Repose-angle and run-out error on held-out geometries
gns-granular.criterion: Repose error at most 1.5 degrees and run-out error at most 5 % on every one of the 20 held-out geometries (SC-011-01)

unet-watershed.title: U-Net against watershed with a Swebrec fit
unet-watershed.reports: Paired difference of the x50 error with its 95 % interval, real and synthetic images stated separately
unet-watershed.criterion: "U-Net beats watershed" only when the interval of the paired difference excludes 0 in its favour, otherwise "no significant difference" (SC-012-03)

unet-tstr.title: Train on synthetic, test on real (U-Net)
unet-tstr.reports: Foreground IoU ratio of TSTR to TRTR on the real test originals over 5 grouped folds, with every fold, the minimum and the spread

fragment-realism.title: Realism of the synthetic fragment images
fragment-realism.reports: Real-versus-synthetic classifier AUC above the real-versus-real AUC, injected-shift AUC, train-versus-test AUC and duplicate flags
fragment-realism.criterion: AUC excess at most 0.10, injected-shift AUC at least 0.80, train-versus-test AUC at most 0.60 and no duplicate flag, for both families (SC-012-04)

il1-sim-to-sim.title: Haul-truck policy, simulator against its browser twin
il1-sim-to-sim.reports: The sim-to-sim gap with its 95 % interval
il1-sim-to-sim.criterion: The gap is reported with its interval; no claim beyond it (SC-014-05)

slope-real-event.title: Slope forecasting on the real monitoring series
slope-real-event.reports: Time-of-failure error at the 50 % and 80 % record cut-offs, described and not tested
slope-real-event.criterion: One real event: reported descriptively, with no "better than" claim (SC-010-03)

onnx-parity.title: ONNX export against the training framework
onnx-parity.reports: Per model: maximum absolute and relative difference and argmax agreement on golden inputs
onnx-parity.criterion: Relative tolerance 1e-3, absolute tolerance 1e-5, maximum absolute difference 1e-4 and 100 % argmax agreement (SC-016-02)

web-engine-parity.title: Browser engines against their Python references
web-engine-parity.reports: The parity verdict of each in-browser engine in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit
web-engine-parity.criterion: Every engine either passes its parity class or is shown as precomputed replay with the note that parity is not confirmed (SC-018-01)

structured-dr.title: Structured domain randomisation against plain randomisation
structured-dr.reports: Paired difference of detector accuracy with its 95 % interval
structured-dr.criterion: "Structured DR better" only when the interval excludes 0 in its favour, otherwise "no significant difference" or "worse" (SC-009-04)

detector-small.title: Small detector on synthetic held-out images

detector-nano.title: Nano detector on synthetic held-out images

il1-route.title: Haul-truck imitation policy, route success
il1-route.reports: Route success without collision over seeded episodes, with its Wilson interval

il1-vs-pid.title: Haul-truck policy against pure pursuit with PID
il1-vs-pid.reports: Each metric with its paired interval
il1-vs-pid.criterion: "Beats pure pursuit with PID" only by the decision rule, per metric (SC-014-04)

il2-fill.title: Excavator policy, bucket fill
il2-fill.reports: Fill factor per episode and the share of stalled episodes
il2-fill.criterion: Fill factor of at least 0.8 in at least 80 % of episodes, stalls in at most 5 % (SC-014-06, SC-014-07)

cosmos-vs-qwen.title: Cosmos Reason against its base model
cosmos-vs-qwen.reports: Per-question-type balanced accuracy with its interval and the McNemar test of the discordant answers
cosmos-vs-qwen.criterion: "Cosmos beats the base model" only if the McNemar p-value is below 0.05 (SC-015-03)

cosmos-task-b.title: Cosmos Reason on the pre-registered chance-level task
cosmos-task-b.reports: Pair accuracy with its 95 % interval against chance
cosmos-task-b.criterion: "Above chance" only by the pre-registered rule against 0.5 (SC-015-05)

tensorrt-engines.title: TensorRT engines against their ONNX models
tensorrt-engines.reports: Latency, throughput, energy and accuracy change per engine, with every rejected variant listed
tensorrt-engines.criterion: Full precision within rtol 1e-3 and atol 1e-5; reduced precision within 1 percentage point; failing variants reported as rejected, none dropped (SC-016-01)

reduced-precision.title: Reduced-precision variants of the published models
reduced-precision.criterion: Absolute change of at most 1 percentage point and mask IoU of at least 0.99 (SC-016-03)

verdict.single: single real event — no significance test
verdict.unavailable: no verdict: the interval is not usable

tstr.label: Ratio of TSTR to TRTR foreground IoU
